# Stockly.ai

> Stock tracking and AI-driven analysis. Curated watchlist with buy/hold/sell zones, earnings momentum picks, and side-by-side AI stock comparisons.

Stockly.ai monitors a curated list of US-listed equities, ETFs, and major crypto tickers across sectors like Big Tech, Semiconductors, AI & Data, Fintech, Quantum Computing, eVTOL, Biotech, Nuclear Energy, and Crypto Assets. Each tracked asset has an AI-evaluated buy/hold/sell price zone, market-dominance indicators, bull/bear/risk targets, and an upcoming-catalysts feed.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Portfolio watchlist with live prices, buy/hold/sell zones, and AI compare.
- [SPY detail](/stock/SPY): Per-ticker analysis page (price, 52-week range, earnings, catalysts, bull/bear/risk).
- [NVDA detail](/stock/NVDA): Example single-stock deep-dive page.
- [AAPL detail](/stock/AAPL): Example single-stock deep-dive page.
